courses.title: Gezond ouder worden (gentle Iyengar classes for healthy ageing)
courses.description: A gentler form of the centre's general Iyengar class, with the poses offered at a less demanding level and more use of chairs, ropes and blocks so the body still gets the full work. It runs three times a week, in the Antwerp studio and live online at the same time, taught by Ann Brosens and Ilythyia De Ligniere.
